_comment: Phase 3 R1 release proof allowlist for tools/phase3-proof/flatdiff.py (format: README.md).

AERO has no entry: its report must be cmp-identical. Revenue, cost of revenue, holder flow and grades get no entry (brief Step 2); the only holder-flow / yields entries are LIT's and PUMP's dilution-derived fields (ruling R21: LIT rel 0.0007, the four net-of-dilution fields rel 0.0008, supply.netPerYear abs 120000 and supply.netPct abs 0.00013 (the 10-12 tranche range, valid through 2027-01-28; final review I-2); PUMP rel 1e-12). LIT has no unbounded dilution glob (fix round 1): every dilution path is an exact entry, burnedPerYear and emissionsPerYear at abs 0, so a new or removed release line fails.

No todo placeholders remain (controller addendum from the prod-copy run): LIT and VVV list the exact provenance / flags paths that run showed; every other asset showed no provenance / flags / checks diff and gets no entry there.

Value pins (final review Minor 1): every LIT / VVV flags / provenance entry carries the exact `old` / `new` value from the prod-copy run (`absent` names the side the path is missing from), so only that removal or addition passes and a replacement value fails. The indexes are positional: if the env's pre-deploy report has the entry at another index, re-derive the globs from it (flatdiff fails closed until then).
